add.event: 道琼斯工业平均指数在衰退开始前两个月见顶于119.6点
add.evidence: The Dow Jones Industrial Average reached a peak of 119.6 on November 3, 1919, two months before the recession began.
A month later it was raised to 6%, and in June 1920 it was raised to 7%
The market bottomed on August 24, 1921, at 63.9, a decline of 47%

add.event: 工业生产恢复至峰值水平
add.evidence: Industrial production returned to its peak levels by October 1922.
